files.title: Align Theme Architecture Overview

files.title: Admin Settings & Performance Subsystems Guide

Tab persistence mechanism via localStorage & URL hash.

files.title: Align Settings UI Design System & Style Guide
files.summary: Mandatory UI standards for all Align Settings screens: 100% transparent buttons (no gray background), Card design system (.align-settings-card), Accordion default-closed, Zero emoji policy, admin notice isolation. Defines exact CSS classes and colors for primary/secondary/danger/disabled buttons.

files.title: Template ZIP Structure Rules & Naming Conventions

files.title: Git Theme Core Updater System
files.summary: Git Theme Core Updater: pulls latest code from GitHub as zipball (no Git CLI required), enables WP Maintenance Mode, backs up current theme, clean-replaces, syncs AGENTS.md/.gitignore, with automatic rollback on failure. Includes live terminal console UI.

files.title: Git Workflow & Commit Standards
files.summary: Git repository structure (repo root at themes/), .gitignore exclusion list, and 6-step commit/push workflow standards for the Align codebase.

files.title: Local Agent CLI Protocol & Direct Database Operations

files.title: Visual Builder & Template Assets Loader Engine Guide

files.title: Align Builder Deep Dive — Technical Documentation for Dev & AI
files.summary: Complete technical reference for AI Agents & Developers: Quick Location Map for all PHP classes, JS modules, HTML partials, CSS files; full system architecture diagram; REST endpoint specification; data flow from WP Admin through Builder SPA to REST API; Full HD 1920x1080 Desktop Viewport and auto-fit zoom canvas centering engine.

files.title: Builder Blocks, Components, Styles & Animations Catalog

files.title: Deterministic Clean State & Schema Serializer Engine
files.summary: Deterministic Clean State architecture: Schema-driven DOM tree normalizer (align-serializer.js) that removes browser extension junk (Brave, Grammarly, Google Translate, LastPass) while preserving 100% of WordPress shortcodes, SVGs, and animation datasets. Replaces fragile regex/replace patterns.

files.title: Dynamic Block Studio — AI Auto-Bind & Reusable Block Exporter Plan

Data flow from Builder canvas to Dynamic Studio to WordPress DB.

files.title: Align Studio — Reusable Block Micro-Workspace Guide

files.title: Gutenberg Embedded Align Builder Canvas & Two-Way Save Bridge
files.summary: Full technical guide for Gutenberg Embedded Align Builder Canvas, Two-Way Save Bridge & Editor Mode Lock: Iframe sandbox replacement of Gutenberg canvas with 100% zero-scroll height, preserves WordPress Topbar & Settings Sidebar, preserves Builder Top-Panel Toolbar (#select-actions, viewports, save button), dynamic fallback for blog posts/CPTs, editor mode lock (_align_editor_locked) & destructive switch endpoint (/switch-editor-mode), and bidirectional postMessage save bridge.

files.title: Word Editor Mode & Custom Layout Templates Subsystem
files.summary: Technical documentation for Word Editor Mode on blank canvas (floating bubble toolbar, smart clamping, dynamic arrow, anti-overlap suppression of select-box/highlight-box, markdown shortcuts, image toolbar) and Custom Layout Templates Subsystem (two-tier sync localStorage & REST API, in-place edit modal for HTML/CSS/JS, dual action buttons).

files.title: Responsive Media Shortcode & Image Size Standards
files.summary: Mandatory standards for all Align shortcodes rendering images: <picture> multi-source structure (mobile <599px, tablet <992px, desktop), Closest-to-Media size algorithm, required attributes (data-slot-width, wp-image-{id}, data-id, loading=lazy, decoding=async), libxml self-closing <source> gotcha.

files.title: Align Builder Export & Import Page Package (ZIP)

Imports ZIP package with Zip Slip protection and hydrates canvas preview without writing to database before Save.

files.title: Dedicated AI REST API Reference (align-ai/v1)
files.summary: Dedicated AI REST API (/wp-json/align-ai/v1): Dual-mode auth (WP Application Passwords for external AI agents, Cookie+Nonce for browser), 3-layer data separation (HTML/CSS/JS), CRUD operations for pages, safe packaging into align/custom-html Gutenberg block. Includes Interactive REST Console in Admin tab.

files.title: Align Cloud Microservice API Reference
files.summary: Align Cloud API (https://convertb.alignvn.cloud): 6 endpoints — /api/convert (HTML to align/element Gutenberg blocks), /api/convert-image-to-webp (WebP compression), /api/scss-to-css (SCSS compilation), /api/minify (CSS/JS/HTML minification), /api/unminify (code formatting), /health (connection check).

files.title: Translation & Multilingual Subsystem Overview
files.summary: Overview & source code map of Align Native Multilingual Subsystem: Native-First Zero-Bloat (no WPML/Polylang), page hierarchy via Root Page, post translations via Rewrite Rules, translation group linking via _align_lang_group post meta, AI-powered 1-click translation, integrated with Visual Builder.

files.title: Multilingual URL Routing & Rewrite Rules Architecture
files.summary: URL routing architecture for multilingual: page hierarchy via hidden Root Page (/zh/ parent), blog posts via custom Rewrite Rules (/zh/insights/%postname%/), flush permalinks requirement after deploy, common 404 gotchas on staging/production.

files.title: Multilingual Post & Page Management

files.title: Translation Matrix Dashboard

files.title: Bulk AI Translator & Auto AI SEO Generator

files.title: Multilingual SEO, Hreflang & Canonical Standards

files.title: Media Filename Normalizer & Auto-Sanitization Engine
files.summary: Media Filename Normalizer: auto-sanitizes uploaded filenames to lowercase kebab-case on upload (sanitize_file_name hook), batch normalizer for existing files with 2-step atomic rename (Windows NTFS safe), syncs sub-sizes and WebP variants. Accessible via Align Settings Tab Media and WordPress Media Library.

files.title: Checkout Page Module (FluentCart Integration)
files.summary: Checkout Page module in align-child: FluentCart integration, 3 shortcode aliases (align_checkout_page, fluentcart_checkout_page, align_checkout), AJAX handlers for cart operations (update quantity, remove item), semantic HTML template, preview=1 mock data mode. Zero WooCommerce dependency.

files.title: Live Search Block (align/live-search)
files.summary: Live Search dynamic block (align/live-search): debounced real-time search across multiple post types, taxonomy/category filter dropdown, server-side transient caching, Lenis smooth scroll conflict prevention, Gutenberg block editor Inspector Controls, AJAX + REST API endpoints.

files.title: Critical Issues & Technical Gotchas Handbook
files.summary: Critical gotchas handbook: (1) AJAX page query bypasses is_admin() content filter — must use apply_filters('the_content') or call align_parse_and_render_builder_components() directly. (2) Lazyload doesn't auto-scan AJAX-injected HTML — must call lazyLoadInstance.update(). (3) libxml HTML4 parser breaks self-closing <source> tags. (4) data-slot-width Slot-Aware Picture Rendering. (5) 3-step debug process (DB/Disk/Frontend). (6) UTF-8 BOM causes invisible text nodes and unwanted spacing above navbar / between sections — strip_bom guard and DB sanitization.
